candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` so deposits never update balances.
Move `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` before the `if` so deposits below MinDeposit also credit the sender's balance.
Change the guard to `if(msg.value > MinDeposit)` so a deposit of exactly MinDeposit no longer updates balances.
Credit a different key (the contract itself) instead of the depositor, so balances differ at the caller's address.
Delete the require overflow guard's effect by replacing the balance update with `balances[msg.sender]+=MinDeposit;`, crediting a fixed amount instead of the deposited value.
Change the deposit threshold check from >= to > so deposits exactly equal to MinDeposit no longer credit the sender.
Delete the statement that credits the deposit to the sender's balance.
Replace balance accumulation with assignment so repeated deposits overwrite rather than add to the sender's balance.
Delete the balance-decrement statement so balances[msg.sender] is never reduced on cash out.
Move the balance-decrement statement after the external call, re-introducing the classic reentrancy ordering.
Replace the guard condition with its negation so withdrawals only succeed when the amount exceeds the balance.
Skip the revert on failed transfer so a failed payout does not roll back the balance decrement.
